subject: Sequenced acceptance roadmap + MSA/DPA/order form sequencing — Cardinal HealthTech
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@cardinalht.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cardinalht.com, Aaron Ford <aford@cardinalht.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Apr 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for pilot — timeline + legal asks

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and Legal asked me to pull together a single plan we can follow to close procurement: MSA, DPA and the order form. They want to see clear milestones, owners, and the minimum evidence required at each gate so they can present it to their procurement committee next Wednesday.

Top asks from my side:
- A short MAP (mutual action plan) we can share with stakeholders.
- Which docs need to be signed first vs can be parallel (MSA vs DPA vs order form).
- A realistic close timeline if we target signature by May 3.

Can you put together a one-page MAP and call out any blockers (SOC2, data retention, KMS) that will add time? Attaching our internal timeline for reference.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Li
Director, Strategic Procurement
Cardinal HealthTech

(attachment: cardinal-internal-procurement-timeline.xlsx)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@cardinalht.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Apr 2028 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sequenced acceptance roadmap + MSA/DPA/order form sequencing — Cardinal HealthTech

Samantha —

Thanks — sending a concise MAP and suggested sequencing below. I attached a working MAP spreadsheet (redwood-MAP-v2.xlsx) and a draft order form. High-level notes first:

1) Dependency principle: we recommend executing the MSA and DPA in parallel where possible, and complete the order form as the final execution once redlines are resolved. The one exception is if Cardinal requires a signed DPA before any data access — in that case DPA must be prioritized.

2) Minimum acceptance gates to hit for pilot sign-off:
  - Security evidence (SOC2 Type II report + encryption/KMS confirmation) — owner: Redwood Security (Neha). Target: 2 weeks to package evidence.
  - Pilot acceptance test (UAT script + success criteria) — owner: Cardinal product + Redwood CS (Vanessa). Target: 1 week of UAT.
  - Invoice/charge plan agreed in order form (billing cadence & seat counts) — owner: Sales/Finance (Karthik).

3) Timeline to hit signature by May 3 (aggressive, but feasible):
  - Apr 3: Redwood sends updated MAP spreadsheet, DPA redlines, and order form draft (attached).
  - Apr 6: Cardinal returns DPA redlines and order form comments.
  - Apr 10: Mutual redline review (legal sync call) to triage blockers.
  - Apr 12–18: Security evidence delivery & open item remediation.
  - Apr 19–23: UAT execution window.
  - Apr 24–28: Final redline reconciliation and sign-off prep.
  - May 1–3: Signature window (DocuSign).

If Cardinal's legal needs additional contract clauses (e.g., specific audit rights, data residency language), add 3–5 business days to the schedule.

Next steps (action items):
- Ive attached redwood-MAP-v2.xlsx with the lanes and owners filled in — please review and mark any changes.
- Neha: will prepare a SOC2 evidence packet and KMS summary; ETA Apr 12.
- Vanessa: please draft a simple UAT plan and success checklist for pilot — ETA Apr 9.
- Samantha: can you confirm whether Cardinal requires a signed DPA before remote access to test data?

Happy to hop on a call Wednesday to walk through the MAP with your procurement/ legal teams.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

(attachments: redwood-MAP-v2.xlsx, orderform-draft-CardinalHT.docx)

From: Aaron Ford <aford@cardinalht.com>

On Wed, Apr 1, 2028 at 12:03 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Samantha —
> 
> Thanks — sending a concise MAP and suggested sequencing below. I attached a working MAP spreadsheet (redwood-MAP-v2.xlsx) and a draft order form. High-level notes first:
> 
> ...

Karthik — thanks for the clear plan. A few clarifications from Legal:
- Cardinal's standard process requires the DPA to be signed or an interim data processing addendum before production data is shared. For a sandbox test dataset we can accept written assurance, but they prefer a signed DPA before full data access.
- We have three DPA redlines that are likely to be pushed back to you: subprocessor list, deletion timelines, and breach notification SLA. Expect the legal team to return tracked changes by Apr 6.

Procurement: for the procurement committee we need a one-page MAP that tracks the critical path, absolute blockers, and dollar impact per milestone. The committee will meet Apr 13 to approve teams to proceed to contract negotiations. If Redwood can commit to the Apr 19–23 UAT window and provide a SOC2 extract by Apr 12, the committee will be comfortable moving forward.

Aaron Ford
Sr. Legal Counsel
Cardinal HealthTech

(attachment: cardinal-legal-dpa-checklist.pdf)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Ford <aford@cardinalht.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@cardinalht.com>

Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sequenced acceptance roadmap + MSA/DPA/order form sequencing — Cardinal HealthTech

Aaron / Samantha —

Appreciate the clarity — quick updates inline and an attached, condensed one-page MAP for the procurement committee. Key callouts:

- DPA priority: we can sign an interim DPA addendum for sandbox access by Apr 8, and target full DPA execution by Apr 20 pending subprocessor and deletion clause agreement.
- SOC2 / security deliverables: Neha is compiling a SOC2 extract, encryption diagram, and KMS summary. We can provide the extract and KMS attestation by Apr 12 as requested.
- UAT / acceptance: Vanessa will share a 5-step UAT script by Apr 9; Redwood CS will be on standby during Apr 19–23.
- Order form: we propose finalizing billing cadence and pilot seat counts in parallel to legal redlines and executing the order form at signature. If Legal needs the order form signed earlier for procurement reasons, we can exchange a signed order form with a conditional clause (signature subject to final DPA) — we can discuss language on the legal sync call.

Attached: condensed-MAP-for-procurement.pdf (single page), and a DPA redline snapshot (DPA-redlines-CardinalHT.pdf) for preview.

Can we schedule the legal sync call for Apr 11 at 10:00 AM PT? If that works for Aaron and your legal team, I'll send a calendar invite and include the redline summary.

Thanks,
Karthik

(attachments: condensed-MAP-for-procurement.pdf, DPA-redlines-CardinalHT.pdf)
